name: KillerStartups

sources.title: KillerStartups homepage — general startup/finance news publication
Contact page — advertising inquiries to info@killerstartups.com

requirements: No self-serve submission or directory exists — the site is an editorial publication (startups, finance, stocks, mindset)
The contact page only advertises 'advertising to a large audience of startup founders' via info@killerstartups.com
Much of the current content reads as staff-written or contributed news coverage
preparation: An email pitch describing the startup and why it merits coverage, or an advertising/sponsored-post inquiry
Company boilerplate, launch metrics, founder names and quotes ready to share
workflow: Email info@killerstartups.com with either a press/coverage pitch or an advertising inquiry
Negotiate scope — the site only publicly offers an advertising contact, so clarify whether editorial coverage or a paid placement is on the table
If accepted, the piece is published as an article on killerstartups.com
watchFor: Historically KillerStartups ran a startup-review feature; the current site shows no submission form — the old route appears retired
The only published contact is framed around advertising — expect paid-placement offers
No public pricing; rates are negotiated over email
Content quality on the site is mixed/SEO-flavored — assess brand fit before paying
countsAsLive: A published article on killerstartups.com profiling or mentioning the startup
unknowns: Whether any free editorial coverage route still exists
Whether outbound links in posts are dofollow
Whether the historical 'submit your startup' review product is still offered on request
